nodes.name: Hermes Authenticate
nodes.notes: POST /api/authenticate {username,password} -> { access_token }. Creds from n8n ENV (HERMES_BASE_URL / HERMES_USERNAME / HERMES_PASSWORD).

nodes.name: Hermes POST Catalogue
nodes.notes: POST /api/productsCatalogue { items:[ONE item] } — sent ONE PER LINE, not batched: Hermes rejects a WHOLE batch (status 0, 'one or more items were not processed') if ANY item's EAN already exists, which blocks the NEW items too. One request per item isolates them: an existing EAN -> status 0 (skipped, fine), a new EAN -> status 1 with a MblaID. Existing EANs are ignored / leading-zero-normalised by Hermes.
